issues.translation_quote: What a stirring speech!
issues.justification: Lena's reply is sarcastic about Grisha's stammering non-answer; 'stirring' reads sincere and loses the irony.

issues.source_quote: Вы, наверное, думаете, что они только мороженое подают? А они подают большие надежды!
issues.translation_quote: They also show great promise!
issues.justification: The pun on 'подавать' (serve / show hope) is lost; 'show great promise' does not echo 'serve ice cream', so the joke fails.

issues.source_quote: Ансамбль пенсии и пляски! Виноват, простите, ансамль Песни и пляски!
issues.translation_quote: The Pension and Dance Ensemble! Sorry! The Song and Dance Ensemble!
issues.justification: The Freudian slip pun (песни/пенсии) is not rendered; 'Pension and Dance' does not sound like 'Song and Dance' with a slip of the tongue, so the gag is lost.

issues.source_quote: Горько, горько! - Что? Горько товарищи, чувствовать, что мы стали на год старше
issues.translation_quote: - Kiss! Kiss! - What? It's bitter, comrades, to feel we're a year older.
issues.justification: The pun on the wedding cry 'Gorko!' is unexplained and 'Kiss! Kiss!' then 'bitter' is incoherent in English; the joke Ogurtsov misunderstanding is lost.

issues.translation_quote: Yee-haw... Yee-haw...
issues.justification: Cowboy exclamation is culturally and tonally wrong for a drunk Soviet lecturer; 'Асса' is a Caucasian dance cry.

issues.translation_quote: Three cubic yards of lumber for that.
issues.justification: Soviet units are cubic meters; 'yards' is inaccurate and unidiomatic for the setting.

issues.translation_quote: It's not typical!
issues.justification: Ogurtsov's bureaucratic catchphrase 'нетипично' is rendered literally, sounding odd; it recurs and also in 'Вот так, ... будет типично', where it becomes incoherent ('That would be more typical'). The Soviet-speak flavor is lost.

issues.source_quote: Я экономист... не для того мы затрачиваем такие средства на обучение, что бы вот так кидаться экономистами!
issues.translation_quote: - I'm an economist.
issues.justification: Fine in itself, but the translation of the 'Нет! Вы, собственно, соображаете' scene omits 'Теперь, сам танец' flow; more notably the humor works, so only minor. (Low confidence.)

issues.source_quote: Сурьёзный человек таким образом не поедет!
issues.translation_quote: No serious person would arrive like that!
issues.justification: 'Сурьёзный' is Ogurtsov's mispronounced catchword (it is deliberately substandard); the translation loses this verbal tic throughout.

issues.translation_quote: Who is she? - Modern technology.
issues.justification: 'Верная помощница' is feminine, so 'Who is she?' is fine, but the translator inserted 'she' which is acceptable; no problem. (Retracted in substance.)

issues.translation_quote: They're making a fool of the director!
issues.justification: Reference to Petrushka (puppet-show buffoon) is flattened; acceptable but loses specific cultural image.

issues.source_quote: Фан-Фан Тюльпан с Онегиным, Ромео, мушкетёр.
issues.translation_quote: Fanfan la Tulipe, Onegin, Romeo and a musketeer.
issues.justification: Acceptable rendering; minor only.

issues.translation_quote: We help them, they help us!
issues.justification: Ogurtsov's cynical formulaic exchange phrase 'мы им, они нам' is rendered with invented content; acceptable but slightly changed.

issues.source_quote: Ну что ж, неплохо, неплохо, только этот хор надо, так сказать, несколько расширить.
issues.translation_quote: Only this choir should be, so to speak, somewhat larger.
issues.justification: Fine. No issue.

issues.source_quote: А и Б играли на трубе!
issues.translation_quote: Just aimless tootling!
issues.justification: The reference to the well-known riddle-rhyme 'А и Б сидели на трубе' (which Ogurtsov garbles) is replaced with an unrelated phrase; the nonsense-quote humor is lost.

issues.translation_quote: - What? - The cats.
issues.justification: The joke 'Коты в сапогах' budget cut works partly, but 'Puss in Boots' being plural with 'cats' loses the 'Cats in Boots' set-up; minor.

issues.source_quote: Хотела бутерброд с сыром, но думаю, бутерброд не пройдёт
issues.translation_quote: I wanted to bring a cheese sandwich, but I thought it wouldn't fit.
issues.justification: 'Бутерброд не пройдёт' (it wouldn't go down/pass for a proper meal) is mistranslated as 'wouldn't fit', creating nonsense.

issues.translation_quote: It's time!
issues.justification: The line follows 'поставьте бутылочку' where Ogurtsov is jabbing at drinking; minor.

issues.translation_quote: [The best cognac in USSR was known as 5*]
issues.justification: Translator's bracketed explanatory note is not in the source and intrudes into the subtitle text; also the stars joke is not rendered as a viable subtitle.

issues.source_quote: Больше ничего известный- неизвестный не сказал?
issues.translation_quote: Did this known stranger say anything else?
issues.justification: Awkward; the oxymoron 'known-unknown' should be rendered as a wry 'Did our mystery man say anything else?'.

issues.translation_quote: Good health to you all!
issues.justification: Elderly folksy diminutive register is lost.

issues.translation_quote: bye-bye
issues.justification: Acceptable, but 'time to go bye-bye' is childish in a different way; minor.

issues.source_quote: Товарищ Усиков?! Не такое оно у меня уж и серое
issues.translation_quote: Mine's not nearly as gray as you think
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.translation_quote: Tosya Burykina ... Tosya Burakina
issues.justification: The name changes in the source are probably an announcer's slip in the original; preserving both is acceptable.

issues.source_quote: Доведя об этом до вашего сведения
issues.translation_quote: In bringing this to your attention
issues.justification: Acceptable.

issues.translation_quote: Yoo-hoo!
issues.justification: Minor flourish; acceptable.

issues.translation_quote: The punch line? Never mind.
issues.justification: The pun relies on 'соль' as 'salt' (the point of the joke); 'The punch line?' makes Ogurtsov's confusion disappear, so his obtuse literalism is lost.

issues.translation_quote: You've thought of everything so originally
issues.justification: Fine.

issues.source_quote: используя прямое моё попадание в ящик, правильно, под видом иллюзии провезения
issues.translation_quote: they took advantage of my direct entry into a box... Yes, that's right...
issues.justification: Ogurtsov's dictation is garbled bureaucratese and 'правильно' is Tosya's confirmation; the rendering is stilted and loses comic officialese.

issues.source_quote: Поздравляю вас, вы замечательно выступали! ... Вы.. Я вас совсем иначе представлял!
issues.translation_quote: You... I'd imagined you quite differently!
issues.justification: Fine.
